args.body:
Summary of websites shared in #general:

1. www.informations.com — Shares the latest job report, which brought a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, renowned for authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional dishes such as cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert. Warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia create a welcoming, rustic atmosphere, and large windows offer panoramic views of the city skyline. Friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire make each visit feel like a journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean introduction that makes it easy to learn a bit about you and find your contact details. My feedback: it's a great starting point, but it would be even better with a bit more personality — for example, a short bio, some of your interests or projects, and maybe links to your other work. A little visual polish (some images or a personal touch) would make it feel more memorable. Overall, a solid and welcoming personal site!

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). It's a nice, straightforward introduction to your blog, and I love that you share your passion for hiking — it gives readers an immediate sense of what your blog is about. My feedback: it would be great to see some actual blog content, like a few post titles or excerpts, along with photos or descriptions from your hikes. Adding a short "About Me" section and links to your favorite trails or gear would make it more engaging and useful for fellow hikers. Overall, a promising start with a lovely theme!
